units.source_text: 他把胳膊伸进去，用手在水缸里捣着。

en.t: He reached his arm in and stirred around inside the water jar with his hand.

units.source_text: 缸底粘着的黑沙子，仅仅弄脏了他的手指尖。

en.t: The black sand stuck to the bottom of the jar only dirtied the tips of his fingers.

units.source_text: 关注点转移了，疼痛的皮肤之下，无数受了伤的蜈蚣，开始挣扎起来。

en.t: As his attention shifted, countless wounded centipedes beneath his aching skin began to writhe.
